av_no_practitioners: There are no practitioners with a calendar yet.
av_load_failed: The hours could not be loaded. Try again.
av_read_only: You can see these hours but not change them.
av_rules_lead: The hours the practitioner can be booked, by day. A day can have several intervals (for example 09:00–13:00 and 15:00–19:00).
av_copy_monday: Copy Monday to every working day
av_copy_lead: This practitioner's saved weekly hours replace those of the ones chosen: for all of them, or for none.
av_copy_refused: The saved hours have problems and cannot be copied. Correct and save them first.
av_one_offs_lead: Days off, closed hours or extra hours, from today on. They take precedence over the weekly hours.
av_one_offs_empty: No one-off days from today on.
av_one_off_add_title: Add a day or a period
av_one_off_times_hint: The times count only for “closed part of the day” and “extra hours”.
av_preview_lead: The free times online booking offers for a service in a week, computed exactly as on the site.
av_preview_service_rules: The step between times and the breaks between sessions are the service's.
av_preview_failed: The preview could not be computed.
av_preview_paused: Online booking is paused now for this practitioner or service: the site offers none of these times.
av_rooms_lead: The days or hours the room cannot be used. Rooms have no weekly hours, only closures.
av_room_open: The room has no closures from today on.
av_saved_copy: The hours were applied to the chosen practitioners.
av_saved_closure: The room was closed for the chosen days.
av_not_saved: Nothing was saved. Check the details and try again.
av_forbidden: You may not make this change.
av_not_found: It no longer exists: it may have been removed meanwhile.
av_reason_too_many_rules: Too many intervals: at most 120 in all.
av_reason_end_before_start: The end time must be after the start time.
av_reason_grid: Times go in 5-minute steps (for example 09:05, not 09:03).
av_reason_no_mode: Choose at least one mode: on site or online.
av_reason_validity: The end date is before the start date.
av_reason_period_start: A period schedule needs a start date.
av_reason_too_many_intervals: At most 6 intervals in a day.
av_reason_overlap: Overlaps another interval on the same day.
av_reason_range_order: The end date is before the start date.
av_reason_range_too_long: A period can be at most 92 days long.
av_reason_times_pair: Fill in both the start and the end time (or neither, for the whole day).
av_reason_open_needs_hours: For extra hours, fill in the interval.
av_reason_dst_gap: That time does not exist on the chosen day: the clocks go forward an hour (daylight saving).
av_reason_duplicate: The day already has exactly this entry.
av_reason_entry_overlap: Overlaps an existing entry on the same day.
av_reason_day_closed: The day is already closed all day.
av_reason_too_many_days: Too many one-off days are kept (at most 1000): remove some old ones.
av_reason_times: Fill in the start and the end time.
av_reason_entry_form: Fill in the date (and the times, when needed).
av_online_lead: Pause booking from the site for the whole organisation, a site, a service or a practitioner. Visitors read your message and, if you wish, can leave a callback request.
av_pauses_empty_text: No pause scheduled or in force.
av_pause_zone_hint: Times are the clinic's (Romania's time). Without “until”, the pause lasts until you lift it.
av_pause_message_hint: Left unchanged, the usual message is used, which follows the choice about callback requests.
av_pause_block_staff: Also block bookings made by staff
av_pause_default_callbacks: Online booking is paused for now. You can call us, or leave a callback request and we will get back to you.
av_pause_default_call: Online booking is paused for now. To book, please call us.
av_flag_staff_free: Staff can still book from the console
av_pause_reason_until_before_from: The end must be after the start.
av_pause_reason_until_past: The end must be in the future.
av_pause_reason_unknown_site: The chosen site does not book into this organisation.
av_pause_reason_unknown_service: The chosen service does not exist.
av_pause_reason_unknown_practitioner: The chosen practitioner does not exist.
av_pause_reason_too_many: Too many pauses are kept (at most 50): remove the ended ones.
av_pause_reason_no_target: Choose the site, service or practitioner to pause.
av_pause_reason_bad_time: Fill in the window's start date and time.
av_banner_whole: Online booking is paused for the whole organisation.
av_banner_part: Online booking is paused for some services or practitioners.
av_banner_staff_free: Staff can still book from the console.
av_booking_paused_staff: Booking is paused now for this service or practitioner, staff bookings included. You can restart it in Settings → Online booking.
av_ac_copy: Apply the hours to other practitioners
av_ac_pause_update: Change a pause of online booking
av_ac_pause_remove: Lift a pause of online booking
